# XferAI-Bench

> Local, offline benchmark for cold-start retail forecasting: an existing item launching at a location group where it has never sold, 52 weekly forecasts, PAIR0-E and PAIR0-N scored separately. Built-in data is synthetic; public rankings are pending.
